rows.parameterName: Fatty oils and resinified essential oils
rows.expectedResultText: The drop evaporates completely within 24 h without leaving any translucent or greasy spot

tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and compliance with the visual specification.

Dilute 0.250 g to 100.0 mL with ethanol (96 per cent). Measure the absorbance from 260 nm to 400 nm. Plot the spectrum; draw tangent AB as baseline; the maximum C is at 315 +/- 3 nm; drop a perpendicular from C to the baseline at D; value = absorbance at C minus absorbance at D.

details.reference: BP Appendix II B (Ultraviolet and Visible Absorption Spectrophotometry)
details.rowsUsingTest: Identification: absorbance C - D (spec line 12); Absorbance: C - D (spec line 16)

tests.procedure: Determine on 5 mL sample with a calibrated refractometer.

details.reference: BP Appendix V E (Determination of Refractive Index)

tests.procedure: Determine on 25 mL sample with a calibrated polarimeter; measure the angle of rotation in a 1 dm (10 cm) tube.

details.reference: BP Appendix V F (Determination of Optical Rotation and Specific Optical Rotation)

tests.procedure: Weigh empty pycnometer Wt1; fill with water and weigh Wt2; discard water; fill with sample and weigh Wt3. Relative density = (Wt3 - Wt1) / (Wt2 - Wt1).

details.reference: BP Appendix V G (Determination of Relative Density)

tests.procedure: Allow 1 drop of the essential oil to fall onto filter paper and observe.

details.reference: BP Appendix X M (Essential Oils, Fatty Oils and Resinified Essential Oils in Essential Oils)

tests.procedure: Weigh a dried beaker (Wt1); introduce 20 mL of sample and weigh again (Wt2); heat on a water-bath for 4 h; cool; weigh the beaker with residue (Wt3). Residue (%) = (Wt3 - Wt1) / (Wt2 - Wt1) x 100.

details.reference: BP Appendix X M (Residue on Evaporation of Essential Oils)
